text:
Yes. Monzo offers an **arranged overdraft of up to £2,000** on its UK personal current account, subject to eligibility. You pay interest only on the amount you actually use, not on the full limit. ([monzo.com](https://monzo.com/overdrafts?utm_source=openai))

The variable effective annual rate (EAR) is **19%, 29% or 39%**, depending on your credit score. You can check your personal rate in the overdraft section of the Monzo app. ([monzo.com](https://monzo.com/overdrafts?utm_source=openai))

For example, at Monzo’s representative rate of **39%**, borrowing **£1,200 for 30 days costs £32.94** in interest. Borrowing less or paying it back sooner costs less. ([monzo.com](https://monzo.com/overdrafts?utm_source=openai))
